//: OPT-IN auto-capture — NOT loaded by default. The active hooks.json ships
empty so the studio never writes to your knowledge base without you asking.
To enable end-of-session reflection, copy the `hooks` block below into
hooks.json and re-enable the plugin. The command is a lightweight nudge to
run /learn; swap it for your own reflection script for fully automatic

hooks.command: echo 'studio: session ended — run /learn to capture any lessons.' >&2
